method: Classification by a property shared by three triples
steps: B: 22+67+22=111 odd, third number even (and first equals third)
B is the odd one out
check_code:
opts={'A':(26,95,21),'B':(22,67,22),'C':(20,15,51),'D':(16,45,21)}
odd=[k for k,(a,b,c) in opts.items() if (a+b+c)%2==1]
assert odd==['B']
assert all((a+b+c)%2==0 for k,(a,b,c) in opts.items() if k!='B')
